verdict.rationale: Jira exposes a REST API that users report is genuinely useful for querying/automating data (jira-comm-20, jira-docs-1), which supports headless/CI use cases, and an official Atlassian MCP server exists for agentic integration (jira-probe-3). However, no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was found (jira-probe-1, jira-probe-2), indicating friction for automated/AI tooling discovery and no explicit CI-oriented documentation in the evidence.
